title: anim.joints/1
description: data/anim/joints.json: the joint limits of rig R1 (render/anim/anim_joints.gd; docs/animation/joint-limits.md). hinges: the elbow and the knee turn about one axis, one way (sign), from min_deg (a little give past straight) to max_deg. balls: every other jointed bone is split into a swing and a twist (twist_deg [lo, hi] for the right-hand side; the left is mirrored); straight_twist_deg is the wider twist while the hinge below is nearly straight. shapes: a scale on those limits for each fighter shape (default for any other). Angles in degrees. Render only, outside the sim's data hash. Version field: schema. Policy: closed except keys starting with an underscore. Cross-references and orders (every bone is in profiles.json bone_lag and in one joint only; a hinge's min is below its max and is the negative of give_deg; a twist range rises and the straight twist is at least as wide; straight_below_deg is below bent_above_deg; every shapes key is `default` or a shape in ragdoll_motion.json) are checked by tools/lib/xref-fight.js (joints-*). Animation's draft: docs/animation/schema-drafts/anim-joints.schema.json.

give_deg.description: How far a hinge may bend past straight.

arm_back_soft.description: An upper arm may not point straight back along the body: its backward reach is squeezed into this share of the axis.

straight_below_deg.description: Below this much flexion the hinge counts as straight (the ball above it may twist further).

bent_above_deg.description: Above this much flexion the twist is back to twist_deg.

retarget_units.description: The pose bake only: how far a hand target may slide forward to the nearest place a comfortable bend can reach.

comfort_twist_deg.description: The twist below which a bend counts as comfortable.

bones.description: Bones in profiles.json bone_lag (checked by tools/lib/xref-fight.js, joints-bone).

sign.description: +1 flexes the lower bone toward +x (the elbow); -1 toward -x (the knee).

bones.description: Bones in profiles.json bone_lag (checked by tools/lib/xref-fight.js, joints-bone).

axis.description: The bone's own axis the twist is measured about (y unless stated).

fix.description: The pose bake slides a free hand forward when the solve would make a chicken wing (AnimPose._is_wing). false: no fix.

suffixes.description: The fix applies to poses whose id ends in one of these (the strikes' contact and follow keys: a dash's arms swept back are meant).

skip.description: Poses the fix leaves alone (rule joints-wing-skip: each is a real pose).

flex_deg.description: A wing's elbow is bent at least this much, in degrees.

up.description: ... carried this far above its shoulder, in units.

drop.description: ... with the hand this far below the elbow, in units.

back.description: ... and this far behind it, in units.

margin.description: A wing's way out is taken this much farther than the first legal place, in units.

runtime.description: How much of the wing fix the live pose takes (0 none, 1 all), so the wing is drawn to the guard on the contact tick.

wing.description: Optional. The chicken-wing fix in the pose bake (docs/animation: homework 4): a free arm whose solve would stick its elbow out is moved to a bent, carried and dropped place.

free_arm_deg.description: The most the free arm turns in one tick on its way to a blow's plane, in degrees (a rate limit bound by the blow's deadline).

slew.description: Optional. Rate limits on the pose bake and the live bend (docs/animation/homework4b.md).
